Per architecture §3.4 (defense-in-depth field redaction), list views * intentionally omit fields that aren't safe for every authorised reader: * date of birth, phone number, manager id (org chart), salary (lives in * its own module). The full {@link EmployeeResponse} returns those * conditionally based on the caller's role and self-flag.
